design: A dangerous stylized giant wasp dungeon enemy with angular yellow-and-black chitin abdomen, narrow amber compound eyes, dark mandibles, two short antennae, SIX thin segmented legs, two large translucent upper wings and two small lower wings, and one clearly pointed rear stinger. Aggressive cheeky insect expression without human lips or cute round eyes. Three-quarter facing RIGHT, hovering with body center fixed. Idle tiny wingbeat variations and antenna twitch, hurt curls abdomen and recoils, attack tilts and thrusts stinger forward toward RIGHT, then recovers, dodge banks back/low and returns. Maintain six-leg anatomy and same markings, no detached effects or duplicate bodies. Wide transparent margins around antennae and wings.
prompt: Correct ONLY ROW THREE COLUMN THREE, the attack impact pose. The wasp must attack with its ABDOMINAL STINGER, not a new long needle/proboscis from its face. Remove the long spike emerging from the head and keep the ordinary short dark mandibles like all other frames. Curve its SAME striped abdomen UNDER the thorax, bringing the pointed rear stinger forward toward the RIGHT, in a readable stinging strike. Keep six legs, same head, antennae and four wings, all natural wasp anatomy. Retain the same body scale and identity. Entire pose fully inside its cell, no neighboring overlap. All other fifteen cells unchanged, same 4x4 transparent sheet, no text/effects.
